effective_capacity_sources: explicit cache partition or allocation when available

modes.name: whole-pipeline
modes.condition: The measured foreground knee plus interference reserve fits the effective cache share.
modes.behavior: Retain the latency-critical parser, style, layout, paint, scheduler, and active-view state together.

modes.name: phase-local
modes.condition: The full foreground knee does not fit, but one pipeline phase and its live inputs do.
modes.behavior: Bound retained derived state and let parse, style, layout, and paint displace one another deliberately.

modes.name: streaming
modes.condition: Even a phase-local set exceeds the effective cache share or memory-pressure policy.
modes.behavior: Chunk traversal, serialize inactive state, reduce memoization, and preserve viewport-bounded work.

cache_model.statement: No cache capacity is a product requirement. The listed capacities are experimental points used to locate workload-specific latency and miss-rate knees; runtime policy follows measured available capacity rather than a marketing number.

covered: browser chrome event and damage paths
HTML, CSS, layout, paint, and scheduler hot state
bounded JavaScript runtime core used by the foreground page
excluded: large page JavaScript heaps and WebAssembly memories
optional_hardware_measurements: LLC loads and LLC load misses

gates.reason: Counter semantics, effective cache share, and workload knees vary by host. No controlled sweep has established mode-selection thresholds.
